condition.name: {@condition Blinded|sw5e-phb}
entries: A {@condition Blinded|sw5e-phb|blinded} creature can't see and automatically fails any {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} that requires sight.\r\n- Attack rolls against the creature have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}, and the creature's {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}.

condition.name: {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb}
entries: A {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed} creature can't attack the {@feat Charmer|sw5e-phb|charmer} or target the {@feat Charmer|sw5e-phb|charmer} with harmful abilities or enhanced effects.\r\n- The {@feat Charmer|sw5e-phb|charmer} has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on any {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} to interact socially with the creature.

condition.name: {@condition Corroded|sw5e-phb}
entries: Some abilities, effects, and hazards can lead to a special condition called {@condition Corroded|sw5e-phb|corroded}. {@condition Corroded|sw5e-phb} is measured in three levels. An effect can give a creature one or more {@condition Corroded|sw5e-phb|corroded} levels, as specified in the effect's description.
For each {@condition Corroded|sw5e-phb|corroded} level a creature has, it takes 1 additional damage from weapons.

condition.name: {@condition Deafened|sw5e-phb}
entries: A {@condition Deafened|sw5e-phb|deafened} creature can't hear and automatically fails any {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} that requires hearing.

items: A {@condition Diseased|sw5e-phb|diseased} creature suffers effects that vary based on the disease.

condition.name: {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb}
entries:
Some special abilities and environmental hazards, such as and the long-term effects of freezing or scorching temperatures, can lead to a special condition called {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion}. {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb} is measured in six levels. An effect can give a creature one or more levels of {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion}, as specified in the effect's description. {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb} Level

|Level|Effect|
|:--:|:--|
|1|{@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb} on {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks}|
|2|{@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb} halved|
|3|{@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} and {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}|
|4|Hit point maximum halved|
|5|{@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb} reduced to 0|
|6|Death|

If an already exhausted creature suffers another effect that causes {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion}, its current level of {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion} increases by the amount specified in the effect's description.

A creature suffers the effect of its current level of {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion} as well as all lower levels. For example, a creature suffering level 2 {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion} has its {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} halved and has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks}.

An effect that removes {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion} reduces its level as specified in the effect's description, with all {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion} effects ending if a creature's {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion} level is reduced below 1.

Finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} reduces a creature's {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion} level by 1, provided that the creature has also ingested some food and drink.

condition.name: {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb}
entries: A {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb} creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} and {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} while the source of its fear is within line of sight.\r\n- The creature can't willingly move closer to the source of its fear.

condition.name: {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb}
entries: A {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb|grappled} creature's {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} becomes 0, and it can't benefit from any bonus to its {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}.\r\n- The condition ends if the grappler is {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb} (see the condition).\r\n- The condition also ends if an effect removes the {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb|grappled} creature from the reach of the grappler or grappling effect.

condition.name: {@condition Ignited|sw5e-phb}
entries: - A creature that is {@condition Ignited|sw5e-phb|ignited} suffers fire damage at the end of each of its turns. A damage value in parentheses appears with this condition—the fire damage the creature takes at the end of its turn.

items: If the target or a creature within 5 feet of it uses an action to put out the flames, or if some other effect douses the flames, the creature is no longer {@condition Ignited|sw5e-phb|ignited}.

condition.name: {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb}
entries: An {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb} creature can't take actions or reactions.

condition.name: {@condition Invisible|sw5e-phb}
entries: An {@condition Invisible|sw5e-phb|invisible} creature is impossible to see without the aid of powers or a special sense. For the purpose of hiding, the creature is heavily obscured. The creature's location can be detected by any noise it makes or any tracks it leaves.\r\n- Attack rolls against the creature have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}, and the creature's {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}.

condition.name: {@condition Paralyzed|sw5e-phb}
entries: A {@condition Paralyzed|sw5e-phb|paralyzed} creature is {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb} (see the condition) and can't move or speak.\r\n- The creature automatically fails Strength and Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}. Attack rolls against the creature have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}.\r\n- Any attack that hits the creature is a {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} if the attacker is within 5 feet of the creature.

condition.name: {@condition Petrified|sw5e-phb}
entries:
A {@condition Petrified|sw5e-phb|petrified} creature is transformed, along with any object it is wearing or carrying, into a solid inanimate substance (usually stone). Its weight increases by a factor of ten, and it ceases aging.
- The creature is {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb} (see the condition), can't move or speak, and is unaware of its surroundings.
- Attack rolls against the creature have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}. 
- The creature automatically fails Strength and Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}.
- The creature has {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to all damage.
- The creature is immune to {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} and disease, although a {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} or disease already in its system is suspended, not neutralized.

condition.name: {@condition Poisoned|sw5e-phb}
entries: A {@condition Poisoned|sw5e-phb} creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} and {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks}.

condition.name: Prone
entries:
A prone creature's only movement option is to crawl, unless it stands up and thereby ends the condition. 
- The creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on melee {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls}.
- The creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} against targets within 30 feet.
- An {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} against the creature has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} if the attacker is within 5 feet of the creature. Otherwise, the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}.

condition.name: {@condition Restrained|sw5e-phb}
entries: A {@condition Restrained|sw5e-phb} creature's {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} becomes 0, and it can't benefit from any bonus to its {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}.\r\n- Attack rolls against the creature have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}, and the creature's {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}.\r\n- The creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}.

condition.name: {@condition Shocked|sw5e-phb}
entries: A {@condition Shocked|sw5e-phb|shocked} creature's {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is reduced by half.\r\n- The creature can't take reactions.

condition.name: {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb}
entries: Some abilities, effects, and hazards can lead to a special condition called {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed}. {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb} is measured in four levels. An effect can give a creature one or more levels of {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed}, as specified in the effect's description.

entries.name: {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb} Level

rows: {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb} reduced to 0, and can't benefit from any bonus to {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}

entries: If an already {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} creature suffers another effect that causes it to be {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed}, its current {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} level increases by the amount specified in the effect's description.

An effect that removes {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} reduces its level as specified in the effect's description, with all {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} effects ending if a creature's {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} level is reduced below 1.

condition.name: {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb}
entries: A {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb|stunned} creature is {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb} (see the condition), can't move, and can speak only falteringly.\r\n- The creature automatically fails Strength and Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}.\r\n- Attack rolls against the creature have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}.

condition.name: {@condition Unconscious|sw5e-phb}
entries:
An {@condition Unconscious|sw5e-phb} creature is {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb} (see the condition), can't move or speak, and is unaware of its surroundings
- The creature drops whatever it's holding and falls {@condition Prone|sw5e-phb|prone}.
- The creature automatically fails Strength and Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}.
- Attack rolls against the creature have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}.
- Any attack that hits the creature is a {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} if the attacker is within 5 feet of the creature.

condition.name: {@condition Weakened|sw5e-phb}
entries: - A creature suffering from the {@condition Weakened|sw5e-phb|weakened} condition heals at a slower rate. When an effect restores {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to the creature, the amount of {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} restored is halved.

items: Creatures suffering from this condition can only add half their ability modifier to {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls}, and {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}, unless that modifier would be negative.
